name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must move the ball away from the door at least once." (Existence(blocker_moved) hard) is redundant because the chain of hard precedence clauses (blocker_moved → has_door_key → door_open → target_picked_up) already forces blocker_moved to occur. Remove this redundant Existence clause and keep the remaining clauses unchanged.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent should not drop the key while the door is still closed." is encoded as a soft Absence(key_lost), which forbids the key_lost event entirely. The task only specifies that dropping the key while the door remains closed should be discouraged, not that it is disallowed at any time. Replace this clause with a soft Response(key_lost, door_open) (or a soft Precedence(key_lost, door_open)) so that the agent is penalised only when key_lost occurs before the door is opened. All other clauses correctly capture the remaining requirements of the task.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must move the ball away from the door." (Existence(blocker_moved)) is redundant – the hard precedence rules already force blocker_moved. Remove this clause; the remaining clauses correctly capture all task requirements.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task explicitly commands that the ball be moved away from the door before taking the key, and that the key be taken in order to open the door and pick up the box. The clause set lacks a hard Existence(blocker_moved) for the ball move and a hard Existence(has_door_key) for picking up the key. Add these two hard goal clauses to correctly capture the task requirements.

texts: Move the ball away from the door.
The ball must be moved away before taking the key.
Open the door after taking the key.
Pick up the box after the door is open.
When holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or later.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.
